user_story: As a user, I want to interact with a horizontal range slider so that I can select a value between the minimum and maximum range. Acceptance criteria: The slider should be visible and functional; when I adjust the slider, the displayed value should update accordingly. The slider is represented by the input element of type 'range': {"tag": "input", "type": "range", "value": "0"}. The current value of the slider is shown in the span element with id 'range': {"tag": "span", "id": "range", "text": "0"}.
